notes.title: How to play local co-op via LAN & Steam
notes.content:
Lobby types
Before creating a lobby, you need to know what type of lobby you are creating. At the time of this publication (1.1.*) there are only 2 lobby types, via STEAM (available only for the Steam version) and LAN (available for the Steam and Android versions)

How to change or lobby type
Changing the lobby type is simple, just go to the settings in the main menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424414/ee9b10e6b94384f1b6bf610bb3959c8bf3d5e30d.png
Then click on the Multiplayer tab and you will be able to change which configuration you want.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424414/229275b8ed89ed8c8525f6ef1cce54e5456303b3.png
Pros & Cons of STEAM
The STEAM version is very stable and does not need any external application to connect with people outside your network, but this only works for players who have the STEAM version.
Pros & Cons of LAN
The LAN type usually has connection issues, and you need an external application to play with people outside your network. The only advantage of LAN is that it works on all current platforms.

Creating a lobby
To create the lobby just click on the following button in the main menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424414/cd4f46e7e95619d3f6b29f4471d9e660a6c2f185.png
For someone to enter your room they will need to discover your ID/IP

How to know your ID (STEAM Type)
To know your ID in STEAM is simple, just press this button and the room ID will be copied to your COPY AND PASTE
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424414/91efedb664832329f8514adbe421a89fbfd555ab.png

How to know your IP (LAN Type)
Knowing your IP is much more complex and will require many more steps.

How to know your IP on PC
To find out your IP on your PC we recommend the Radmin VPN application but it can be any application of your choice.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424414/449c8cf6a82e51bd61b59c9e24ab94af0fe678fa.png
Once in the app you will know your IP here. Of course, you will need to create a room within the app to play with people outside of your network, but if the person is already in your network then it will not be necessary.
How to know your IP on ANDROID
Knowing your IP on Android requires even more steps. We won't recommend any Android apps, but we will show you how to know your IP so you can play with people on the same network.
Enter network settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424414/6635ec289aff6d317f6a2ea66902caf84ad760cb.png
Click this button on the network you are connected to.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424414/d2570717d780a79743c552c8b63654f6cbc41cc4.png
You will be able to see your IP here, it should be a sequence of numbers like 123.456.789.123
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424414/5cbb06a67d0891b57b20831a8cf73d3831f19fc9.png

How to connect
Now you just need to send your ID (if you are using the STEAM type) or IP (if you are using the LAN type) to whoever will play with you (the person needs to make sure that they are using the same type of server as you). After that, the person who will join just needs to copy the number you sent and press the following button
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424414/91efedb664832329f8514adbe421a89fbfd555ab.png

Feel free to ask any questions

notes.title: FEAR OF THE UNDEAD 1.1 UPDATE
notes.content:
In version 1.1 of Fear of the Undead we decided to rebuild the game from scratch, bringing more stability and multiplayer functionality to all maps. There are many changes, so here is a simplified list:

New HUD
3 levels of Hell Rift
New weapon category system
New bullet type system
New perk system
Stable multiplayer
Multiplayer via Steam
Crossplay with the Android version (only works using LAN)
New accessibility settings
Support for TOUCH screens
New map structure for PALMARES and CHALLENGER
New character upgrade system
Skins for characters
Support for ULTRAWIDE screens
Resolution scaling adapts to screen size
Steam Cloud support

And many other small changes!
In short, the experience is now much smoother, more stable and enjoyable.
